official_definition: Ultra Armor: Color(/Color) - This Spirit/Ultimate is unaffected by opposing Color(/Color) Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Ultra Armor] or [Ultra Armor: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Ultra Armor]", "give [Ultra Armor]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
